stories.title: Crackdown on massage parlors in Prince George's County leads to 46 arrests, 11 closures, police say
stories.summary: Police in Prince George's County say they have arrested 46 people and closed 11 businesses in connection with an investigation into illegal massage parlors operating across the county.

stories.title: With Thanksgiving just a week away, here are a few items to make dinner prep much easier
stories.summary: Want to spend less time in the kitchen and more time with your guests this Thanksgiving? Tv-Host Kathy Copcutt joins us with a few items to make things easier this holiday season.

stories.title: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore makes more staff changes ahead of second term
stories.summary: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore has announced more changes to his leadership team as he prepares for his second term.

stories.title: Cold mornings, pleasant afternoons this week in Maryland
stories.summary: Many neighborhoods recorded the first freeze of the season on Monday morning.

stories.title: MikksKakes is gearing up for Thanksgiving with an assortment of holiday desserts
stories.summary: Mikki Smith, owner, joins us in studio with an array of pies, cakes, cupcakes and banana pudding that are all available to order on her holiday menu.

stories.title: Having holiday family conversations about aging and supporting loved ones
stories.summary: As families get ready to gather for the holidays, Dr. Nana Yaw Adu-Sarkodie, a Baltimore geriatrician and author, shares important tips on how to approach family conversations with care and respect.

stories.title: Around Town: Decorating cakes and more with Daisy Baked It
stories.summary: Stephanie Douglas is live at The Cake Studio by Daisy Baked It checking out some of her cake and sip options that are perfect for date night or girls night out.

stories.title: Police say driver intentionally struck and killed pedestrian after altercation in Baltimore, suspect flees

stories.summary: The Supreme Court left in place a lower court decision that upheld the measure banning guns in sensitive places.

stories.title: Chilly mornings, but a beautiful week ahead in Maryland
stories.summary: WJZ-TV meteorlogist Steve Sosna has your latest weather forecast.

stories.title: Man killed, 2 others wounded in shooting at Baltimore shopping plaza
